name: Wallabag
description: Self-hosted read-it-later — save articles, read offline, and organize with tags
author: Crow

env_vars.name: WALLABAG_CLIENT_ID
env_vars.description: Wallabag OAuth2 client ID (API clients management)

env_vars.name: WALLABAG_DB_PASSWORD
env_vars.description: MariaDB password (Docker database). Generated by Crow at install; never shown.

notes: Self-host via Docker (multi-container: app + mariadb + redis) or connect to existing (set WALLABAG_URL + OAuth2 credentials). Crow replaces the shipped wallabag/wallabag admin login at install and writes WALLABAG_USERNAME/WALLABAG_PASSWORD into this bundle's settings itself, so the MCP server logs in with no extra step; the password is in Settings → Passwords. Create an API client in Wallabag under Developer > Create a new client, then put its id and secret into WALLABAG_CLIENT_ID/WALLABAG_CLIENT_SECRET. To keep an account of your own, set WALLABAG_USERNAME to it before installing: Crow then leaves that login alone.
